svg.aria-label: A ten-by-ten grid of numbers (correct of 225), rows are checkpoints after each teach, columns are skills; cells above the diagonal are blank; values are stable down each column except Oriel.
svg.text: Accuracy on the fixed 225-row panels at every accepted checkpoint
Rows: checkpoint after each teach. Columns: skill. Cell: correct of 225 (exact match)
blank = not yet taught at that checkpoint
Each cell is the number of exactly-correct answers on that skill's fixed 225-row held-out panel at that checkpoint. Source:
plots/data/derived/tables.json (matrix), from the panel analysis receipt.
